dialogues.speaker: Machinna
dialogues.text: It doesn't matter how long you hesitate, the result won't change, so you might as well just give up already.

dialogues.speaker: Kumayo
dialogues.text: No, that isn't how it works. You have to assess the team's overall strength, then consider all possible outcomes of each match...

dialogues.speaker: Kumayo
dialogues.text: Pff, you're a fine one to talk!

dialogues.speaker: Machinna
dialogues.text: Our boy's only telling you how it is. You've bet on so many matches now, yet despite all your "calculations," your bets haven't turned out any better than his random guesses.

dialogues.speaker: Kumayo
dialogues.text: That's just because the sample size is too small! You wait and see. Once I've bet on a load more, I'll create a graph with all the data...

dialogues.speaker: Izze
dialogues.text: ...And then spend another three weeks washing dishes?

dialogues.speaker: Kumayo
dialogues.text: Tsk, more meaningless speculation! If you're going to make random guesses anyway, why don't you give your old pa the benefit of the doubt, for once?
